title: Toy Story (1995)
overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
overview_es: Cuando el orgullo de Woody se ve amenazado por la llegada del nuevo juguete espacial Buzz Lightyear, ambos terminan perdiéndose y deben aprender a superar sus diferencias. Tras vivir múltiples aventuras juntos, logran convertirse en grandes amigos y regresan a casa con Andy.

title: Jumanji (1995)
overview: When siblings Judy and Peter discover an enchanted board game that opens the door to a magical world, they unwittingly invite Alan -- an adult who's been trapped inside the game for 26 years -- into their living room. Alan's only hope for freedom is to finish the game, which proves risky as all three find themselves running from giant rhinoceroses, evil monkeys and other terrifying creatures.
overview_es: Cuando los hermanos Judy y Peter descubren un juego de mesa encantado, liberan sin querer a Alan, un adulto atrapado en su interior durante 26 años. Para recuperar su libertad, los tres deben terminar la peligrosa partida mientras escapan de aterradoras criaturas selváticas.

title: Grumpier Old Men (1995)
overview: A family wedding reignites the ancient feud between next-door neighbors and fishing buddies John and Max. Meanwhile, a sultry Italian divorcée opens a restaurant at the local bait shop, alarming the locals who worry she'll scare the fish away. But she's less interested in seafood than she is in cooking up a hot time with Max.
overview_es: Una boda familiar aviva la antigua enemistad entre los vecinos y pescadores John y Max. Mientras tanto, una seductora divorciada italiana abre un restaurante que preocupa a los locales, aunque ella solo busca conquistar a Max.

title: Waiting to Exhale (1995)
overview: Cheated on, mistreated and stepped on, the women are holding their breath, waiting for the elusive "good man" to break a string of less-than-stellar lovers. Friends and confidants Vannah, Bernie, Glo and Robin talk it all out, determined to find a better way to breathe.
overview_es: Cuatro amigas inmersas en relaciones fallidas se apoyan mutuamente para superar el desamor y encontrar la felicidad que merecen. Juntas, están decididas a cambiar sus vidas y aprender a respirar de nuevo.

title: Father of the Bride Part II (1995)
overview: Just when George Banks has recovered from his daughter's wedding, he receives the news that she's pregnant ... and that George's wife is expecting too. He was planning on selling their home, but that's a plan that—like George—will have to change with the arrival of both a grandchild and a kid of his own.
overview_es: Justo cuando George Banks se recupera de la boda de su hija, se entera de que ella está embarazada y que su propia esposa espera un hijo. Esta inesperada doble noticia lo obliga a cambiar sus planes de vender la casa para adaptarse a la llegada simultánea de un nieto y un nuevo hijo.

title: Heat (1995)
overview: Obsessive master thief Neil McCauley leads a top-notch crew on various daring heists throughout Los Angeles while determined detective Vincent Hanna pursues him without rest. Each man recognizes and respects the ability and the dedication of the other even though they are aware their cat-and-mouse game may end in violence.
overview_es: Un meticuloso ladrón de bancos y un incansable detective de Los Ángeles se persiguen mutuamente en un juego de gato y ratón, reconociendo y respetando la habilidad del otro. Ambos saben que su inevitable enfrentamiento final podría terminar en violencia.

title: Sabrina (1995)
overview: After her return from school in Paris, a playboy finally takes notice of his family's chauffeur's daughter Sabrina, who's long had a crush on him, but he questions his more serious brother's motives when he warns against getting involved with her.
overview_es: Tras regresar de París, una joven que siempre ha estado enamorada de un playboy finalmente llama su atención, mientras su hermano mayor le advierte que no se involucre con ella.

title: Tom and Huck (1995)
overview: A mischievous young boy, Tom Sawyer, witnesses a murder by the deadly Injun Joe. Tom becomes friends with Huckleberry Finn, a boy with no future and no family. Tom has to choose between honoring a friendship or honoring an oath because the town alcoholic is accused of the murder. Tom and Huck go through several adventures trying to retrieve evidence.
overview_es: El joven Tom Sawyer presencia un asesinato cometido por Injun Joe y, junto a su amigo Huckleberry Finn, vive varias aventuras para buscar pruebas y salvar de la culpa al alcohólico del pueblo. Dividido entre guardar silencio o romper su juramento, Tom demuestra su valentía para hacer justicia.

title: Sudden Death (1995)
overview: When a man's daughter is suddenly taken during a championship hockey game – with the captors demanding a billion dollars by game's end – he frantically sets a plan in motion to rescue her and abort an impending explosion before the final buzzer.
overview_es: Durante un partido de hockey, un padre desesperado debe rescatar a su hija secuestrada y evitar una catástrofe antes de que suene la chicharra final. Para lograrlo, pone en marcha un peligroso plan contra reloj para cumplir con la millonaria exigencia de los captores.

title: GoldenEye (1995)
overview: When a powerful secret defense system is stolen, James Bond is assigned to stop a Russian crime syndicate from using it.
overview_es: James Bond debe recuperar un poderoso sistema de defensa robado para evitar que una organización criminal rusa lo utilice.
